text:
maria: Ok team — POC for a 'burst-bucket ramp weave' generator for apples-to-apples perf tests. Goal: exercise kernel selection and KV warmup across staggered QPS ramps and microbursts. Draft config below. Need thoughts on batching heuristics and cache priming.

jonah: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) can we deterministically seed KV cache so replay is repeatable? 2) include a 'cold_fraction' param to force cold starts in a controlled way.

sasha: For batching heuristics, prefer size-based gating + max-wait-ms. We saw regressions when only wait-based used (more jitter -> worse kernel choices). :eyes:

maria: Agree. Proposal: gate by batch_size=32, max_wait_ms=5, and adaptive backoff when latency crosses p99 threshold. Pseudo-config: 
```json
{
  "generator": "burst-bucket",
  "buckets": [ { "qps": 50, "dur_s": 30 }, { "qps": 500, "dur_s": 10 }, { "qps": 200, "dur_s": 60 } ],
  "ramp": { "shape": "log", "steps": 5 },
  "burst": { "microburst_rate": 8, "burst_weight": 0.12 },
  "kv": { "seeded": true, "cold_fraction": 0.08, "warmup_window_s": 120 },
  "batching": { "batch_size": 32, "max_wait_ms": 5, "adaptive_backoff": { "p99_threshold_ms": 180, "backoff_ms": 10 } }
}
```

kai: Also add kernel-selection hint map keyed by seq_len buckets. Example: seq<=256 -> kernel-v1, 257-1024 -> kernel-opt, >1024 -> kernel-v2. If runtime reports persistent contention fallback to single-threaded kernel. Also include kv-warmup_window_s=120 as proposed.

perf-bot: run: `loadgen --config burstbucket.json --replay-id=2026-03-10T15:00Z`
summary: p50=12ms p95=85ms p99=240ms — KV misses correlate with p99 spikes.

meera: Can we add a histogram-shaped long-tail shaper? E.g. sample interarrival from Pareto with alpha parameter so we can tune tail heaviness. formula: P(X>t) ~ (t/xm)^-alpha. That lets us sweep alpha to stress p99 without changing mean QPS.

jonah: I'll add a smoke harness that runs the same replay with kernel-v1/v2 and produces apples-to-apples tokenized workload. Will push branch `eng/runtime/burstbucket-proto`.

maria: Thanks. Two more things: 1) make KV-seed deterministic per-replay-id so we can correlate misses across runs, 2) if perf-bot shows >20% p99 regression vs baseline auto-fail the PR. I'll open a short RFC once we have the first run results.

perf-bot: note: attach raw histogram + per-kernel CPU/gpu util logs to the run artifacts. Use `--artifact-path` to upload.

jonah: ack, will do.

maria: Great — next step: get a stable run tonight and compare kernel-selection traces. Short sync tomorrow if regressions show up. :thumbsup:
